description: This file provides security-related functions for generating and verifying JWT tokens using HS256 signing. It includes utility functions for base64 URL-safe encoding/decoding, and exposes public interfaces for creating access tokens and verifying them, relying on project settings for secret keys and token expiration configuration.

methods.name: str _b64url_encode(data: bytes)
methods.description: Encodes bytes to a base64 URL-safe string without padding.

methods.name: bytes _b64url_decode(data: str)
methods.description: Decodes a base64 URL-safe string to bytes, adding padding if necessary.

methods.name: str create_access_token(sub: str, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token with a subject and optional expiration, encoding header and payload, and signing with HMAC SHA256.

methods.name: dict verify_token(token: str)
methods.description: Verifies a JWT token signed with HS256, checks signature validity, expiration, and returns the payload as a dict.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(sub: str, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None) -> str:$/
